AgentCommandOut.description: What the Agent sees after claim/progress/result.
AgentCommandOut.title: AgentCommandOut

AgentConfig.description: Sent at registration and on every heartbeat (D-035 #9).
AgentConfig.title: AgentConfig

AgentOut.description: FR-4.4: one row of the Agents view.
AgentOut.title: AgentOut

AgingRow.description: One party, or the side's total (ledger_id None).
AgingRow.title: AgingRow

Amount.description: SRS 5.8. amount_raw is kept exactly as received, for audit only (ACC-DATA-1).
Amount.title: Amount

AnomaliesOut.description:
`available` is false while the feature flag is off, with a reason - the same shape
payment behaviour uses for its gate, rather than a second disabled-section convention.
AnomaliesOut.title: AnomaliesOut

AnomalyOut.description:
One flag: the evidence the application computed, and separately whatever Claude wrote
about it (FR-3.7 - the UI must keep the two apart).
AnomalyOut.title: AnomalyOut

AnomalyRule.description: anomaly_flags.rule_triggered. Free text until P15 (D-032); now checked.
AnomalyRule.title: AnomalyRule

BatchEnvelope.description:
One upload batch (D-005). Records are sorted by alter_id ascending (D-026) and belong
to the envelope's collection (or are its key list).
BatchEnvelope.title: BatchEnvelope

CustomFieldsUpdate.description: The complete list of mappings (DR-UDF-1); a mapping left out is switched off.
CustomFieldsUpdate.title: CustomFieldsUpdate

DisclosureOut.description:
What enabling the feature will send to Anthropic (D-055 #7). Generated from the same
`redact()` the explainer uses, so it cannot drift from the truth.
DisclosureOut.title: DisclosureOut

DrilldownOut.description: FR-DD-5: the rows, across all pages, sum to `total` exactly.
DrilldownOut.title: DrilldownOut

ExplanationHealthOut.description:
D-055 #3: how often an explanation is discarded, so the model choice can be revisited
with data rather than opinion.
ExplanationHealthOut.title: ExplanationHealthOut

Figure.description:
A flow is signed as the metric defines it. A balance is its size with Dr/Cr. When a
balance is unavailable (a ledger with no opening, ACC-9.6) `amount` is null and the
ledgers are named (D-045 #3).
Figure.title: Figure

FinishRequest.description: How the Agent saw the run end; `close_run` decides the stored status (D-040 #1).
FinishRequest.title: FinishRequest

GroupOut.description: A group with what it resolved to (D-001); names are current, identifiers stable.
GroupOut.title: GroupOut

HeartbeatRequest.description: AGT-1.1, VER-1.1. Send `confirmed_tally_guid` whenever Tally can be read.
HeartbeatRequest.title: HeartbeatRequest

KeyListChunk.description:
One chunk of a key list for deletion detection (SYNC-5.1, D-041). The keys come from
the collection's key-only report, which repeats the very Collection (and filter) its data
report pulls. `window` limits which local records can be marked missing: a DATE window
for vouchers, or null for the whole collection.
KeyListChunk.title: KeyListChunk

KeyListOut.description: Where a key list stands (D-041 #1); `waiting_for` lists chunks still missing.
KeyListOut.title: KeyListOut

KeyListStatus.description: D-041: a key list is staged while RECEIVING, then evaluated once.
KeyListStatus.title: KeyListStatus

KeyRecord.description: Key-only export for deletion detection (FR-1.2, GATE-G21).
KeyRecord.title: KeyRecord

LedgerClosingBalanceRecord.description: Tally's own closing balance as of a date, for reconciliation (GATE-G19, D-048).
LedgerClosingBalanceRecord.title: LedgerClosingBalanceRecord

OpeningBill.description: A bill outstanding at books-beginning, held on the ledger master (D-022, GATE-G31).
OpeningBill.title: OpeningBill

OptionOut.description: A choice for an FR-4.3 filter picker.
OptionOut.title: OptionOut

ParseError.description: One record that could not be parsed; parsing continued (SYNC-6.5).
ParseError.title: ParseError

PaymentBehaviourOut.description:
FR-PAY-1-6, D-049 #5. Until gate G25 passes, `available` is false and nothing is
computed (FR-PAY-6).
PaymentBehaviourOut.title: PaymentBehaviourOut

RankingOut.description:
A ranked list (TOPN-1.x). There is deliberately no total of the listed rows: a Top-N
list is never presented as adding up to the reference total (TOPN-1.4).
RankingOut.title: RankingOut

ReconciliationRow.description: REC-1.2: the Tally value, the local value, both differences and the result.
ReconciliationRow.title: ReconciliationRow

ReconciliationStatus.description: FR-4.1: the home view's reconciliation status.
ReconciliationStatus.title: ReconciliationStatus

ReconciliationStockRecord.description:
Tally's closing quantity read for reconciliation, moments after the run stored its
snapshot; never written to stock_snapshots (GATE-G18, D-048 #3).
ReconciliationStockRecord.title: ReconciliationStockRecord

ReconciliationTotalRecord.description:
Tally's own debit and credit sums for one (ledger, voucher type, period), over the
sync's voucher Collection with cancelled vouchers left out (GATE-G36, D-048 #4). The
backend classifies them exactly as it classifies synced entries.
ReconciliationTotalRecord.title: ReconciliationTotalRecord

ReleaseRequest.description:
`complete` + `start_max_alter_id`: a FULL pull of this collection finished; the
watermark may move to the max ALTERID read BEFORE the pull began (D-039 #2).
ReleaseRequest.title: ReleaseRequest

ReviewRequest.description: CLAUDE.md rule 14: every request body is a Pydantic model.
ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest

RunProblem.description: Something the Agent could not sync (D-040 #2); recorded in sync_errors.
RunProblem.title: RunProblem

ScheduleUpdate.description: agent_id cannot change (RTE-1.3): sending it is a 422.
ScheduleUpdate.title: ScheduleUpdate

SettingsUpdate.description: Partial update; values are validated against app/core/settings_registry.py.
SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate

StockSnapshotRecord.description: Tally-computed closing quantity as of a date (SRS 11.3, GATE-G18).
StockSnapshotRecord.title: StockSnapshotRecord

TokenResponse.description: The refresh token is never in the body: it is an HttpOnly cookie (D-051 #1).
TokenResponse.title: TokenResponse
